Name: DahniMae's Fae Animals for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions for DahniMae's and littlemissgogo's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7565]DahniMae's Fae Animals[/url] were open so I've taken the liberty of updating it to 1.6! The fae animals are now all their own stand-alone animals. This mod adds:

2 Cows
1 Sheep
4 Chickens
1 Duck﻿
1 Dinosaur

They produce their vanilla counterpart's items for now, I may come back and make some new stuff for them in the future.

Enjoy!
